subject: SSO login failure - details attached
body: We're seeing single sign-on failures affecting every user, starting since we changed our identity provider's SSO settings. The one change on our side around that time: an admin changed a binding/protocol setting while cleaning up our SSO config. What we've already checked: reverted a couple of other settings, this one's still broken. Please let us know what artifact or evidence you need from us to pin this down.
